examples.text: Winners were likely to ignore their opponents completely.
examples.translation: 获胜者很可能会完全忽视对手
examples.speechText: Winners were likely to ignore their opponents completely.

examples.text: Since his wife died, he has thrown himself into the research work.
examples.translation: 自从妻子去世后，他就全身心投入了研究工作。
examples.speechText: Since his wife died, he has thrown himself into the research work.

examples.text: As in other institutions of higher learning, ballet students receive monthly government stipends in their last four years, varying（vary的-ing形式） from 160 to 200 rubles ($16 to $20).
examples.translation: 与其他高等院校一样，芭蕾舞学生在最后四年里每月会获得政府津贴，金额从160卢布到200卢布不等，相当于16至20美元。
examples.speechText: As in other institutions of higher learning, ballet students receive monthly government stipends in their last four years, varying from 160 to 200 rubles ($16 to $20).

examples.text: I will pay a visit to my old friend the minute she comes back from abroad.
examples.translation: 她一从国外回来，我就去看望这位老朋友。
examples.speechText: I will pay a visit to my old friend the minute she comes back from abroad.

examples.text: Allow things to settle with time.
examples.translation: 让事情随着时间慢慢平息下来。
examples.speechText: Allow things to settle with time.

examples.text: My most negative opinion is that we don't have any privacy anymore because everything about us is now recorded someplace.
examples.translation: 我最不满的一点是，我们已经没有任何隐私了，因为如今有关我们的一切都被记录在了某个地方。
examples.speechText: My most negative opinion is that we don't have any privacy anymore because everything about us is now recorded someplace.

examples.text: But when it comes to teaching a large lecture hall of 100-plus first-year students, first impressions are make or break.
examples.translation: 但要给100多名一年级学生的大班授课时，第一印象往往决定成败。
examples.speechText: But when it comes to teaching a large lecture hall of 100-plus first-year students, first impressions are make or break.

examples.text: The road to the island only appears when the tide has receded.
examples.translation: 只有退潮后，通往那座岛的道路才会显露出来。
examples.speechText: The road to the island only appears when the tide has receded.

examples.text: A smile has proven to have a positive effect on the mind and soul.
examples.translation: 事实证明，微笑会对人的思想和心灵产生积极影响。
examples.source: （2021年真题·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: A smile has proven to have a positive effect on the mind and soul.

examples.text: “It’s like water turning from a liquid to a solid form,” says Katsuhiro Nishinari, a physicist at the University of Tokyo.
examples.translation: 东京大学物理学家Katsuhiro Nishinari说：“这就像水从液态变成固态一样。”
examples.speechText: “It’s like water turning from a liquid to a solid form,” says Katsuhiro Nishinari, a physicist at the University of Tokyo.

examples.text: In 2002 an amazing 89 percent of workers said they were very satisfied or somewhat satisfied with their jobs.
examples.translation: 2002年，竟有89%的劳动者表示，他们对自己的工作非常满意或比较满意。
examples.speechText: In 2002 an amazing 89 percent of workers said they were very satisfied or somewhat satisfied with their jobs.

examples.text: She was educated（educate的过去分词形式） at the local Amherst Academy and Mount Holyoke Women’s Seminary.
examples.translation: 她曾就读于当地的阿默斯特学院和霍利奥克山女子学校。
examples.speechText: She was educated at the local Amherst Academy and Mount Holyoke Women’s Seminary.

examples.text: Besides, to stop children from using these services just because crimes（crime的复数形式） are being committed online would be like telling them not to attend college because students may have accidents on campus.
examples.translation: 此外，仅仅因为网络上存在犯罪行为就禁止儿童使用这些服务，这就像是告诉他们不要去上大学，理由是学生在校园里可能会遭遇意外。
examples.speechText: Besides, to stop children from using these services just because crimes are being committed online would be like telling them not to attend college because students may have accidents on campus.

examples.text: Haglund believes the app can teach responsible spending habits, whereas schools tend to focus more on economic theories（theory的复数形式）.
examples.translation: Haglund认为，这款应用能够教会孩子负责任的消费习惯，而学校往往更侧重经济理论。
examples.speechText: Haglund believes the app can teach responsible spending habits, whereas schools tend to focus more on economic theories.

examples.text: This new instrument is far superior to the old one we bought three years ago.
examples.translation: 这台新仪器远比我们三年前买的那台旧仪器好。
examples.speechText: This new instrument is far superior to the old one we bought three years ago.
